**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the problem or limitation you're hitting.

**Proposed solution**
Describe the feature you'd like to see added.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you've thought about.

**Is this feasible on ESP32-C6?**
Consider RAM (~300 KB free), Flash (~186 KB free in app partition), and CPU (RISC-V 160 MHz single-core).

**Additional context**
Links to relevant specs, libraries, or prior art.
